translation: All 102 English phrase translations replaced with the corrected supplied 12-page PDF, in the same order. Hebrew visible text and nikkud preserved exactly.
footnotes: All 63 PDF notes retained in full, including continuations across PDF pages, source-label emphasis and source links. Full Bereishis 6:3 added to the existing Chullin 139b and Rashi note.
shiurDiscussionNotes: Thirteen middle Amidah blessings: Berakhot 28b:20-23; Megillah 17b-18a. The mapping suggested in the shiur is labeled as a suggestion.
Rambam's middle path: Hilkhot De'ot 1:4-7 and Shemonah Perakim 4.
Adam's prayer for rain: Rashi on Bereishis 2:5:2.
974 generations: Chagigah 13b:14-14a:1; distinguished from the worlds created and destroyed in Bereshit Rabbah 3:7.
Og and Eliezer: Soferim 21:9 with Da'at Zekenim on Bereishis 24:39:1, including the qualification about two kings called Og.
Those who remained in Egypt: Rashi on Shemos 10:22:2 and 13:18:3; suggested application to Dasan and Aviram distinguished from the source.
David, Ruth and Moav: Bereishis 19:30-38; Ruth 4:13-22.
Milah and desire: Bereishis 21:4; Moreh Nevukhim III:49; adjacent Yisrael Kedoshim 9:4 parallel preserved.
Echad, thirteen and Chanukah: Me'or Einayim, Mikeitz 1. The exact Maharal passage recalled in the shiur was not identified and is not asserted as verified.
The covering from itself: Bereshit Rabbah 21:5; Tanya, Likkutei Amarim 21:8. Marked as a source note for the alternate transcript, since the brief spoken phrase was not clearly recoverable.
Riding above materiality: Maharal, Gevurot Hashem 29:6 and Derekh Chayim 5:19:4. The donkey riding Bilaam is explicitly identified as a metaphor, not the literal verse.
excludedFromCanonicalText: Unattributed anecdotal asides and the contemporary CEO illustration remain outside Rav Tzadok's canonical interlinear text.
verification: Primary source passages retrieved and checked for the added discussions. PDF note quotations are retained as the user's corrected source edition; no claim is made to a new independent facsimile collation of all 63 notes.
publication: Restore the last successful complete Pages artifact, match live fingerprints, patch only the bounded edition and its derived indexes/archives, verify Hebrew and PDF alignment, test desktop/mobile before deployment, and re-read the live files after deployment.
